decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed single storey rear extension to the dwellinghouse is generally consistent with the character of the existing dwellinghouse and will not have any adverse impacts on the amenity of the adjoining properties or the street scene. The proposal is compliant with the provisions of Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Section 1 of the Residential Extension Guidelines. Where the proposal is non-compliant it is considered that there will be no undue adverse effects caused by this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
